enemies.name: Emerald Gummy Serpent
enemies.behavior: Slithers steadily through curved orchard chutes, tea aqueducts, and cavern tunnels toward Mochi's chamber.
enemies.attackPattern: Continuous spline advance (+1.8% to +2.4% danger/sec); lunges faster (+35% burst) for 2 seconds if the player makes 2 invalid swaps in a row.
enemies.weakness: Sensitive to Cryo Freeze Blasts, Kulfi matches, and counterweight gate slams.
enemies.counterStrategy: Prioritize drain-column matches and keep a Freeze Blast or Blue/Kulfi match ready when danger passes 70%.
enemies.visualIdentity: Segmented glossy emerald-lime dragon-serpent with expressive yellow slit-eyes, dorsal lime ridges, and comical chomping white fangs.
enemies.gameplayInteraction: Directly drives the real-time Danger Meter and triggers Mochi's nervous/scared animations as distance shrinks.
enemies.defeatAnimationConcept: Gets bonked harmlessly on the snout by the closing rescue gate, sees cartoon stars, and coils backward down the chute.

enemies.name: Golla-Gulp (Giant Candy-Eating Creature)
enemies.behavior: Plump, wide-mouthed magenta-and-cream puff-beast perched beside the puzzle board, eyeing the player's target fruit candies!
enemies.attackPattern: Every 3 moves, extends a stretchy chameleon-like tongue onto the board to gobble up to 3 candies of the player's Main Objective fruit color—advancing its belly-meter toward Mochi's platform!
enemies.weakness: Gets a comical 'sour brain-freeze' hiccup if tricked into swallowing a Striped Candy, Wrapped Candy, or tangy Darjeeling Orange cluster!
enemies.counterStrategy: Match away target fruits before its 3-turn tongue telegraph lands, OR slide a Striped/Wrapped candy onto its targeted tile so it swallows a fizzy pop and spits back +5 bonus fruits!
enemies.visualIdentity: Round bouncy berry-colored gourmand creature wearing a tiny chef's bib with expressive hungry eyes.
enemies.gameplayInteraction: Marks 3 target board cells with a fork-and-spoon reticle 1 turn before slurping them.
enemies.defeatAnimationConcept: Burps out a shower of sparkling rainbow candies, pats its full round belly happily, and naps peacefully.

enemies.name: Brass Clockwork Automaton
enemies.behavior: Polished brass-and-teakwood wind-up toy guardian patrolling warehouse and carnival tracks strictly on player move ticks (no real-time rush—pure tactical chess!).
enemies.attackPattern: Advances 1 track node per player move; every 4th move, turns its wind-up key to lock 2 board tiles in Wrought Metal Chains.
enemies.weakness: Overwinds and stalls for 2 turns when hit by a Striped Laser aligned with its column or jammed with Riverboat Winch.
enemies.counterStrategy: Take time to plan high-efficiency combos (since it only moves when you move!) and snipe its column with vertical Striped blasts.
enemies.visualIdentity: Charming vintage brass clockwork knight-bot with a spinning golden dorsal wind-up key and glowing amber monocle.
enemies.gameplayInteraction: Converts real-time panic into pure move-efficiency survival puzzles.
enemies.defeatAnimationConcept: Its dorsal wind-up key spins harmlessly free with a playful cuckoo-clock spring boing as it bows politely.

enemies.name: Foothill Snow-Kulfi Golem
enemies.behavior: Lumbering, goofy snow-and-pistachio-ice creature stomping down Himalayan foothill ledges.
enemies.attackPattern: Inhales deeply for 1 turn, then exhales a frosty gale across a 2x3 board zone, encasing candies in `OBS_GLACIER_ICE_BARRIER`.
enemies.weakness: Immune to Freeze Blast! Instead, melts and shrinks rapidly when countered by warm `CANDY_CRISPY_JILAPI` coils, Orange/Litchi matches, or Chili-Sugar warmth.
enemies.counterStrategy: Do NOT bring cryo tools—equip Artisan Mallet or Jilapi Spark Bomb and match warm red/orange candies to melt its frost armor.
enemies.visualIdentity: Fluffy snow-white and mint-ice golem with waffle-cone shoulder pads and frosty eyebrows.
enemies.gameplayInteraction: Subverts player reliance on Freeze Blast by demanding warm-color combos instead.
enemies.defeatAnimationConcept: Melts down into a cheerful miniature snowman waving a tiny waffle flag.

enemies.name: Sizzling Caramel Salamander
enemies.behavior: Glowing amber-crust lizard skittering along cauldron rims and bridge ropes.
enemies.attackPattern: Drops 1 `OBS_CHILI_EMBER_FIRE` spark onto the board every 8 seconds while heating the Caramel Lava beneath Mochi.
enemies.weakness: Takes double pushback from `CANDY_TENDER_COCONUT`, `CANDY_PISTACHIO_KULFI`, Kulfi Ice Cannon, and Tender Coconut Extinguisher.
enemies.counterStrategy: Cool its glowing shell with blue/aqua matches or Foam Extinguisher to turn its shell into brittle sugar-glass, then shatter with any combo.
enemies.visualIdentity: Translucent glowing butterscotch-orange gecko with flickering cartoon flame tail.
enemies.gameplayInteraction: Links board fire-control directly to arena lava-rise speed.
enemies.defeatAnimationConcept: Cools into a shiny harmless amber candy statue that slides smoothly off the ledge.

enemies.name: Armored Jawbreaker Roller
enemies.behavior: Alternates between curled 'Invulnerable Rolling Ball' stance (2 turns) and uncurled 'Dizzy Breather' stance (2 turns).
enemies.attackPattern: While curled, rolls rapidly down ramps and shrugs off normal blasts; shakes loose 2 board blockers on wall impact.
enemies.weakness: Deflecting its roll with a `TOOL_RASGULLA_BOUNCE_PAD` or hitting it WHILE uncurled deals 3x pushback!
enemies.counterStrategy: Save Special Candies during its curled roll phase, then unleash a chain cascade the moment it uncurls!
enemies.visualIdentity: Cute roly-poly creature with concentric rainbow jawbreaker armor plates.
enemies.gameplayInteraction: Teaches burst-damage timing windows instead of mindless spamming.
enemies.defeatAnimationConcept: Bounces harmlessly off a spongy cushion like a pinball and rolls cheering into a hammock.

enemies.name: Sticky Gur-Slime Blob
enemies.behavior: Bouncy lime-molasses jelly creature oozing down bamboo chutes.
enemies.attackPattern: Coats 2 board candies in `OBS_STICKY_MANGO_SLIME` every 9 seconds; if hit by a raw Bomb without water, splits into 2 smaller fast blobs!
enemies.weakness: Dissolves cleanly without splitting when hit by `TOOL_MONSOON_WATER_BLASTER` or `CANDY_TENDER_COCONUT` splash matches.
enemies.counterStrategy: Use hydro/coconut cleanses rather than dry explosives.
enemies.visualIdentity: Wiggly translucent chartreuse jelly cube with two floating googly eyes inside.
enemies.defeatAnimationConcept: Washes away into sparkling clean bubbles leaving behind a shiny Rainbow Bomb on the board.

enemies.name: Acrobatic Canopy Glider
enemies.behavior: Mischievous Mechanical-Winged Sugar Glider swooping over Litchi Orchards and River Markets.
enemies.attackPattern: Hovers above a Special Candy or Golden Key for 2 turns (casting a circular shadow), then dives to carry it 2 rows UPWARD away from the exit!
enemies.weakness: Blown off-course immediately by `TOOL_TEA_LEAF_GUST_FAN` or matching candies directly inside its shadow reticle.
enemies.counterStrategy: Watch for the circular shadow reticle on Key columns and match beneath the Key before the 2-turn dive completes.
enemies.visualIdentity: Playful aviator-goggled glider critter carrying a tiny woven fruit basket.
enemies.gameplayInteraction: Creates vertical tug-of-war on Key-drop missions.
enemies.defeatAnimationConcept: Gets spun around by a gust of wind, drops a bonus fruit bundle, and glides off waving.

enemies.name: Faceted Crystal Sentinel
enemies.behavior: Floating geometric crystal construct guarding Chapter 10 cavern bridges.
enemies.attackPattern: Holds a reflective front shield that blocks vertical beams from below while firing slow laser locks onto the board.
enemies.weakness: Vulnerable from the SIDES—bank a Striped laser off `OBS_CRYSTAL_PRISM_MIRROR` or `OBS_COCONUT_HUSK_BUMPER` to strike its unshielded flank!
enemies.counterStrategy: Use board prisms and angled bumpers to route horizontal beams into its crystal core.
enemies.gameplayInteraction: Turns match-3 laser routing into geometric trick-shot puzzles.
enemies.defeatAnimationConcept: De-materializes into a harmonic chord of floating prism sparkles.

enemies.name: Tangle-Vine Stilt Crawler
enemies.behavior: Long-legged wooden stilt-bug striding across Sundarbans creeks.
enemies.attackPattern: Wraps vine tendrils around 1 built bridge plank or board column, locking it in `OBS_BAMBOO_WOOD_CAGE`.
enemies.weakness: Dazzled by `TOOL_LANTERN_FLARE_BEACON` and knocked back by heavy `CANDY_MADHUPUR_JACKFRUIT` L/T matches.
enemies.counterStrategy: Keep Firefly Beacon or Jackfruit clusters ready to snap its stilt-vines.
enemies.visualIdentity: Whimsical animated driftwood-and-leaf stilt walker with glowing amber lantern antennae.
enemies.gameplayInteraction: Threatens already-completed bridge segments if player stalls.
enemies.defeatAnimationConcept: Tangles its own stilts comically and tumbles onto a soft moss bank.

enemies.name: Swirling River-Current Eel
enemies.behavior: Playful electric-blue ribbon eel circling Mochi's ferry boat during monsoon crossings.
enemies.attackPattern: Spins a mini-whirlpool every 2 moves that rotates a 2x2 block of board candies clockwise AND tugs Mochi's ferry backward 10%.
enemies.weakness: Calmed by matching `CANDY_BARISAL_GUAVA` (buoyant fruit) or stunning with Striped lightning.
enemies.counterStrategy: Anticipate its clockwise 2x2 board rotation—clever players let the eel rotate a 4th candy into a 5-in-a-row match!
enemies.visualIdentity: Sleek bioluminescent turquoise ribbon-fish with golden whisker fins.
enemies.gameplayInteraction: Introduces rotational tile manipulation on flooded boards.
enemies.defeatAnimationConcept: Leaps in a cheerful dolphin-arc over the ferry leaving a rainbow spray.

enemies.name: Orchard Prism Chameleon
enemies.behavior: Perched on overhanging branches, shifting its glossy skin color after every turn to match one of the active board candy colors!
enemies.attackPattern: Advances stealthily unless players match candies of its CURRENT displayed skin color; matching wrong colors gives 0 pushback!
enemies.weakness: Rainbow Color Bomb hits ALL colors at once, or `TOOL_LANTERN_FLARE_BEACON` locks its color for 3 turns.
enemies.counterStrategy: Watch its bright crest color badge in the arena and match that exact fruit color (or paint 3 candies with `TOOL_SYRUP_CONDUIT_BRUSH`).
enemies.visualIdentity: Expressive curly-tailed cartoon chameleon with kaleidoscope crystal scales.
enemies.gameplayInteraction: Demands real-time attention to enemy visual state before choosing which match to take.
enemies.defeatAnimationConcept: Blushes bright polka-dot pink, tips its leaf hat, and zips up into the canopy.

bosses.name: Mist-Coiled Tea Serpent Matriarch

phases.mechanic: Slithers through twin Sylhet waterwheel aqueducts while exhaling `OBS_TEA_MIST_CLOUD` over 3x3 board zones. Matching Mandarin Oranges or firing Gust Fan clears mist and exposes her golden collar target.
Reverses the Rotating Waterwheel Gates every turn and spits Sticky Sap onto drain columns. Dropping 2 Brass Tea-Chest Keys while draining 40 marbles triggers the Giant Waterwheel Splashdown!

bosses.weakness: Mandarin Orange zest bursts + Striped blasts aligned with open Waterwheel paddles.
bosses.defeatSequence: Swept gently down the tea-terrace flume slide in a giant sparkling bubble.

bosses.name: Captain Clamp — Brass Mangrove Crab-Sub

phases.mechanic: Armored brass crab-craft pinches Mochi's orchard rope-bridge with Left & Right Mechanical Claws (represented by 2 armored `OBS_BRASS_TREASURE_TRUNK` locks on cols 1 & 6).
Launches 2 Canopy Glider drones to lift your Keys while rising mud bubbles below. Unlocking both Claw Trunks drops its periscope shield so Special Candies deal full damage!

bosses.weakness: Jackfruit L/T shockwaves + Prism/Wrapped blasts once both Claw Trunks unlock.
bosses.defeatSequence: Pops confetti from its brass smokestack and sputters backward into the creek.

bosses.name: Maharaja Gulp — The Grand Sweet-Guzzler

phases.mechanic: Inhales whole rows of candies toward its coral-cove barge while Coconut Husk Bumpers guard the board flanks.
Opens its cavernous mouth for a 'Mega-Slurp' every 3 turns: players must bank Striped lasers off the 45-degree Coconut Bumpers OR feed it 3 Wrapped/Jilapi fizz-bombs to overfill its sweet-meter!

bosses.weakness: Feeding Special Candies into its telegraphed slurp beam deals 40 stun damage per special!
bosses.defeatSequence: Floats skyward like a giant cheerful parade balloon after eating too many fizzy candies.

bosses.name: Kanchen-Frost — The Glacier Yeti Colossus

phases.mechanic: Freezes outer columns in 2-layer Glacier Ice and rolls twin Spiked Jawbreakers down the Darjeeling trestle track.
Summons Foothill Wind gusts that slide candies sideways each turn; players use Golden Jilapi Coils & Rasgulla Bounce Pads to deflect its own boulders back into its ice shield!

bosses.weakness: Deflected boulders + warm Jilapi/Litchi combos (immune to cryo tools!).
bosses.defeatSequence: Its giant ice-armor cracks open to reveal a tiny friendly snow-marmot riding inside!

bosses.name: Charkha-Bot — The Grand Carnival Automaton

phases.mechanic: Synchronized with 2 Piston Candy Crushers and 2 Rotating Pinwheel Gates on the board; marches strictly on move ticks while chaining unattended specials.
Activates a Countdown Escape Shutter! Players must keep the shutter cranked above 40% while detonating 4 Special Combos to short-circuit its master gear.

bosses.weakness: Double-Special combos (Striped + Wrapped / Rainbow + Striped) overload its brass dynamo.
bosses.defeatSequence: Transforms into a dazzling carnival ferris-wheel firework fountain as Mochi rides the gondola to safety.

bosses.name: Emperor Chroma-Fang — The Three-Headed Prism Serpent

phases.mechanic: Three elemental serpent heads (Ruby Ember Head, Sapphire Frost Head, Emerald Slime Head) guard the Crystal Jungle Sanctum! Each head projects its hazard (`OBS_CHILI_EMBER_FIRE`, `OBS_GLACIER_ICE_BARRIER`, `OBS_STICKY_MANGO_SLIME`) onto the board.

Submerges the bottom 2 rows in Monsoon Crystal Tide (dual-gravity!) while rotating 2 `OBS_CRYSTAL_PRISM_MIRROR` nodes in the center of the board. Players bank Striped/Rainbow beams through the prisms to stun all 3 heads!

Final Desperation Chase! All 3 heads merge into a Prism Super-Serpent racing down the spiral chute while Mochi sprints for the Grand Golden Portal. Drop the Final Royal Key + charge the 100% Rainbow Prism Mega-Cannon for the ultimate rescue blast!

bosses.weakness: Prism-split Rainbow + Striped mega-combos hit all 3 heads simultaneously!
bosses.defeatSequence: Shatters its dark crystal crown in a breathtaking full-screen rainbow aurora, turning back into three harmless baby gummy geckos as Mochi celebrates on the Grand Trophy Terrace!
